[NERR.14.2] **A detail string you return must stay valid until the outermost
public call that reports your status returns.** A pump that fires several
callbacks reports the first non-OK status ([NCBK.1.5]), so your detail can
reach the integrator only when the pump returns, after your callback has. Static
literals are simplest; if you build a message, allocate it per engine and free
it at teardown.
